name: Acid Wind
body:
School conjuration [acid]; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a dried lemon peel)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area one 5 ft. square
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You call forth a breeze full of stinging acid droplets from your outstretched hand that deal 1d6 points of acid damage per 3 caster levels (max 3d6) to everything in the target square. The acid quickly loses its potency, leaving behind a sticky, wet film of water.
